levels.name: Street / station-hall level (Rautatienkatu side, station hall, the tunnels under the tracks)
levels.note: No signposted level names were found in any source. OSM puts the station hall shops, the travel-centre tunnel (Matkakeskustunneli), the Rongankatu underpass and the closed Asematunneli on level 0, with the platforms one floor up; 0.5 is the stair landing between them.

levels.name: Platform level (raiteet 1–5)
levels.note: Three platforms for five tracks: one at track 1 by the station building, an island for tracks 2–3 and an island for tracks 4–5. Track numbers are the ones VR and Nysse use ('tracks 1-5'). Which track lies at which platform comes from the Digitraffic track lines (track 1 and 2 only 4.5 m apart, so no platform between them) and OSM.
levels._source: Wikipedia 'Tampere railway station', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tampere_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; Nysse 'Trains in the Nysse area', https://nysse.fi/en/ways-to-get-around/train.html, read 2026-10-30; Digitraffic infra-api laiturit TPE L1–L5 (Väylävirasto / Fintraffic, CC BY 4.0), read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-TPE.json), read 2026-10-30

open: Signposted level names: none found (no published station plan).
Levels' heights: no source measures them.
Signposted platform names (e.g. 'laituri 2' vs 'raide 2–3') not confirmed; sources speak of tracks 1–5.
No published station plan from VR/Väylä/City of Tampere found; vayla.fi project pages (tampereen-henkiloratapiha/liikennejarjestelyt) would not load.
Shop hours other than Robert's Coffee are OSM's opening_hours (R-Kioski and Hemingway's pages did not load); not checked against the shops.
Whether shops inside the closed Asematunneli (e.g. Asematunnelin Silmälasi) are reachable now is unknown.
Platform heights: laser gives ~0.68–0.72 m above rail for L2/L4/L5 vs register class korkea 0.55 m (see 3D pass flags).

answers.question: Current entrances, lifts and passages during the station-yard rebuild (City of Tampere / Nysse)
answers.answer: Open: the main entrance from Hämeenkatu/Rautatienkatu; the Matkakeskustunneli (travel-centre tunnel, south end, open 24 h, with a lift and a pair of escalators up to each of the three platforms); the Rongankatu underpass (north end, accessible, lifts and stairs to all platforms); Sorinsilta and Lapintie (and Erkkilänsilta) for crossing the yard. Closed for the whole project: the Asematunneli (station tunnel) and the Itsenäisyydenkatu underpass for pedestrians/cyclists. From Tammela, Tulli and the Tulli tram stop, go through the travel-centre tunnel. There is no VR service point.

answers.question: Which platform each lift/escalator reaches is OSM only (the city and VR confirm lifts/escalators in the travel-centre tunnel and lifts via the Rongankatu underpass, not per platform).
answers.answer: Lifts serve platform 1, platform 2/3, platform 4/5 (Settled by geometry. The south row (refs 10945956/57/58) serves 1, 2/3 and 4/5. The north row at Rongantunneli (B1NE5084/5085) serves 2/3 and 4/5.)
